name: expandable-screen
blurb: Card morphs into full-screen modal with smooth layout animation.
description: An ExpandableScreen using Framer Motion; trigger card animates into full-screen content with customizable animation duration; includes close button.
use_when: Creating immersive card-to-fullscreen experiences like image galleries, portfolios, or modal reveals.
avoid_when: For simple modals without animation — use shadcn Dialog to reduce bundle size.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; body overflow locked when expanded; click outside or close button collapses.
